Class 6 Admission (JNVST)

Eligibility

Student must be studying in Class 5.
Must apply for the JNV of the district where the student is studying.
Generally, age should be between 9 and 13 years (as per the official notification of the admission year).
Exam Pattern

Mental Ability Test (Reasoning)
Arithmetic Test (Mathematics)
Language Test
Objective-type questions with no negative marking.

Class 9 Lateral Entry Admission

Eligibility
Student must be studying in Class 8 in a recognized school.
Must belong to the same district as the JNV applied for.
Admission is against vacant seats available in Class 9.

Exam Pattern

English
Hindi
Mathematics
Science
Objective-type questions.
